info.name: Smart School API (Full + Super Admin)
info.description: Complete Smart School REST API including Super Admin SaaS console APIs under /api/saas/* (super_admin session required). Set base_url to your server URL.

item.name: Login (pick your role)
item.description: Run ONE of these first. Postman saves the session cookie automatically.

request.description: Login as School Admin. The response sets the httpOnly smart_school_session cookie (web) and also returns the session as the `token` field in the JSON body — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a mobile/Flutter app. Redirects to /admin.

Login as Teacher. The response sets the httpOnly smart_school_session cookie (web) and also returns the session as the `token` field in the JSON body — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a mobile/Flutter app. Redirects to /portal.

Login as Student. The response sets the httpOnly smart_school_session cookie (web) and also returns the session as the `token` field in the JSON body — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a mobile/Flutter app. Requires students.user_id linked to the login.

Login as Parent. The response sets the httpOnly smart_school_session cookie (web) and also returns the session as the `token` field in the JSON body — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a mobile/Flutter app. Sees only kids linked via student_guardians.

Login as Super Admin. The response sets the httpOnly smart_school_session cookie (web) and also returns the session as the `token` field in the JSON body — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a mobile/Flutter app. Omit schoolCode entirely - redirects to /saas.
Current user, role, permissions and school.
Clear the session cookie.
Step 2 of login for 2FA accounts — challengeToken + authenticator code (or backupCode).
Check whether 2FA is enabled on my account.
Start 2FA setup — returns secret + QR code (still disabled until confirmed).
Confirm setup with an authenticator code (returns one-time backup codes).
Turn off 2FA (password confirmation).
Public self-registration of a new school + its admin (default password Admin@123). No auth required.
